purpose: Diagnose why five development-Pareto Defensive strategies diverged sharply on the already-consumed preserved50+TEST17 replay without fitting a repair.

allowed: consumed DEV50 development population and frozen GA outputs
preserved50 reconstructed replay population and frozen replay results
consumed TEST17 reconstructed population and frozen replay results
no_mutation_authority: no post-replay feature selection for optimization

questions.question: How many statistically distinct observations did DEV50 really provide after clustering by session, bear episode, overlapping holding window, ticker and signal family?
measurements: event counts by ticker, date, episode and family
unique signal dates and date concentration
simultaneous-event concentration
overlapping holding-window concentration
cross-ticker return correlation within episodes
cluster-aware effective sample size approximations

questions.question: Is replay degradation concentrated in particular bear episodes rather than broadly across stocks?
measurements: development versus replay return, drawdown, trade count and utilization by episode for PF1-PF5
episode contribution to CAGR and drawdown degradation
rank stability of finalists by episode

questions.question: Is replay degradation primarily cross-sectional stock selection sensitivity?
measurements: per-ticker contribution distributions in development and replay
concentration of profits/losses in top and bottom tickers
leave-one-ticker and leave-cluster descriptive sensitivity where computationally feasible
sector/cap analysis only if surviving metadata are available without protected-data access

questions.question: Did the strategy rely on signal families whose opportunity frequency or economics changed between DEV50 and replay?
measurements: candidate-event mix by family and horizon
selected/traded event mix by family and horizon for each finalist
family-level return contribution
development versus replay family distribution shift

questions.question: How much of the apparent sample size and edge came from the ticker-by-ticker computational-search preselection layer?
measurements: candidate IDs per ticker/family/horizon
candidate-event duplication and near-duplication
share of trades generated by a small number of per-ticker optimized candidates
compare candidate-layer baseline economics between development and replay without creating new strategies

questions.question: Why did PF1 retain substantial positive CAGR while PF2-PF5 degraded more severely?
measurements: PF1 condition activation rates development versus replay
PF1 family/horizon/ticker/episode concentration
PF1 return and drawdown contribution by episode
compare PF1 morphology with failed finalists descriptively

interpretation_rules: Do not select a repair threshold or new chromosome from 50+17.
Distinguish event count from independent information content.
Treat preserved50 as preserved-not-pristine and TEST17 as consumed diagnostic evidence.
A finding may motivate a new hypothesis, but that hypothesis must be frozen before any untouched evidence is accessed.
If candidate preselection materially explains the divergence, subsequent discovery architecture must address that layer before another protected validation.
